title: TrinityCore upstream reference for CoA research
primaryUse: 3.3.5 branch as comparative upstream reference for historical Vanilla, Burning Crusade and Wrath data, instance scripts, NPC and spell logic, quests, combat events, SQL and core APIs
rules: CoA/Conquest Reborn custom code and validated live client observations outrank TrinityCore data
Do not treat TrinityCore entries, IDs, cooldowns or creature behavior as verified on Conquest Reborn
Keep exact repo, branch, commit, path, line and verification status for each extracted record
Prefer branch 3.3.5 when targeting 3.3.5a client; wotlk_classic and master are cross-check references only
Do not import modern-only or Cataclysm+ mechanics into the 3.3.5a addon datasets
Confirm redistribution terms and preserve required third-party licenses when importing source code; use links and extracted research facts by default
Do not automatically deploy or use historical stock boss timers as predictive DBM-CoA timers
plannedApplications: DBM-CoA encounter detection, mechanics and evidence-backed timers
Questie-X quests, NPCs and objective behaviors
Details and WeakAuras spell and combat event cross-checks
BoneArchive searchable source/provenance references and historical comparisons
status: Source registered for research; this does not mean an entire TrinityCore source/database mirror was imported or deployed to the website
